title: Enabling Auto Clean-Up of Duplicate Landmine Agents

blocks.text: You can enable the auto clean-up feature to automatically delete landmine agents with duplicate hostnames from the Agent Configuration page. The most recently connected hostnames and the ones that are connected for less than 7 days are retained.
Landmine agents deleted via auto clean-up are not uninstalled from the system. You have to manually uninstall them.
To enable the auto clean-up of duplicate landmine agents:

blocks.item: Go to Settings > Endpoint Settings > Agent Configuration.
Under the Auto Clean-Up Duplicate Agents section, select Enabled.
